description: Defines a templated UniqueVector class implementing a set-like container with unique elements, using an internal hash set for fast lookups. Includes node structures, hash set implementation, and utility methods for managing the collection.

classes.name: UniqueVector
classes.description: A set-like container that maintains unique elements in insertion order, optimized for appending and lookup.

classes.name: UniqueVectorHashSet
classes.description: A hash set implementation used internally by UniqueVector for fast element lookup.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds an element to the vector if it does not already exist.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Extracts the internal vector, clearing the container.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if an element exists in the set.

methods.name: IndexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a given element, or kIndexNone if not found.
